# Veyago

> Veyago Inc. is an independent New York software studio that builds privacy-first
> iOS apps and fast, hand-written websites for small businesses. A New York
> C-Corporation, two people, no account managers, fixed prices in writing.

Two lines of work sit under one bar. The apps are private by design: on-device where
it can be, no ad trackers, no dark patterns, yours to own rather than to rent. The
client work is the same discipline applied to someone else's business - hand-written
HTML, CSS and JS (React only when a site genuinely needs it), SEO handled as the site
is built, hosting set up in the client's own account, and the code, repository and
domain owned outright by the client.

The site itself carries no third-party scripts, analytics or cookie banner. Content is
published in English, Dutch (/nl/) and German (/de/); the three are translations of one
another, not separate offers.

  A person replies within one working day; outages are acknowledged the same working day.
- Kept: on the Apple App Store since 29 June 2026. Free to download, with a single
  $29.99 Lifetime unlock. No subscription. iPhone only - there is no Android version.
- Veyago travel: in build, launching Q4 2026 for iPhone and Android. Free to download,
  with optional Premium at €4.99 a month or €29.99 a year.
- Websites: fixed price from $699 / €750 excluding tax. Launch $699/€750, Business
  $1,690/€1,790, Back office from $3,900/€4,100. Care plan $49/€49 a month, optional.
- "Veyago" names three things: Veyago Inc. (the company), Veyago travel (the travel app,
  at veyago.app), and veyago.cloud (this site). Kept is a separate product.

## Services

- [Websites for business](https://www.veyago.cloud/websites/): Fixed-price websites for small business - landing pages from $699 / €750 excl. tax, multi-page business sites, SEO, and the dashboards, CRMs and admin tools behind them. Packages, what costs extra, process and FAQ are all on the page.
- [Product and app work](https://www.veyago.cloud/services/): Design and engineering for people building a product rather than a marketing site. Quoted per project; how an engagement runs is answered on the page.
- [Our approach](https://www.veyago.cloud/approach/): The principles the work is held to - privacy by design, on-device where it can be, no dark patterns, fair pricing, yours to own.

## Apps

- [Kept](https://www.veyago.cloud/kept/): A private, on-device tracker for warranties, receipts, documents, subscriptions and expiry dates. iPhone. Free, with a $29.99 one-time unlock. No accounts, no servers, nothing leaves the device.
- [Veyago travel](https://www.veyago.cloud/veyago/): A trip-decision app - a bracket tournament that narrows up to 80 destinations to one, solo or with a group - then plans the trip. iPhone and Android, Q4 2026.
- [All apps](https://www.veyago.cloud/apps/): Both apps side by side, and what every app in the catalogue is held to.

## Research and writing

- [Projects](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/): The research that comes before a build, and where each idea sits in the pipeline.
- [The Unkept Life](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/the-unkept-life/): The research behind Kept - the cognitive cost of personal life administration, and why a private, on-device answer is now possible. 5,000 words, 12 cited sources, by Cassian Drefke.
- [The Edge Moves In](https://www.veyago.cloud/projects/the-edge-moves-in/): On-device inference and what moves off the cloud as consumer hardware catches up. 3,700 words, 15 cited sources, by Cassian Drefke.
- [Field notes](https://www.veyago.cloud/journal/): Articles on fast, private websites - why builder sites are slow, what a fixed-price website includes, and taking an AI prototype to production.
- [Feed](https://www.veyago.cloud/feed.xml): RSS for the field notes and the research papers.
